notes: One crash was found and fixed during verification: the reader assumed stats.rtf always exists, which broke on a temporary payload whose stats only carry the fields the pipeline had at that moment.

Two self-inflicted regressions were found and fixed: the results hook re-fetched on every `enabled` toggle (collapsing 72 rows back to 36 on return) and cleared pages without refetching on a query change.
The history view endpoint silently dropped reader_position/playback_position and defaulted an omitted position to 0, resetting playback on every scroll. Fixed and re-verified.
